_schema._about: Content for /join (the creator roster page, replacing the reference's careers page). Light page in the reference's career spirit: eyebrow + h1 + sub + one pill; a 'who we are looking for' list; four numbered 'how it works' steps in the reference's numbered-list style; a pay block; a six-item accordion; then the apply block with a checklist and a mailto CTA (there is no form on this site; applications are an email to hello@hypjam.com with a prefilled subject and body). British English.
_schema.hero: {eyebrow, h1, sub, cta:{label, href}} - cta.href is apply.mailto.href.
_schema.looking_for: {eyebrow, h2, items[]} - five strings, rendered as a hairline-separated list with a jam dot.
_schema.faq: {h2, items:[{q, a}]} - identical to faq.json's creators group; keep them in sync.
_schema.apply: {eyebrow, h2, p, checklist[], mailto:{href, subject, body}, button:{label, href}, privacy:{text, link_label, href}} - mailto.href is the fully encoded link; subject and body are the raw strings it encodes, in case the page agent builds the link itself.

meta.title: Join the creator roster: paid UGC briefs, no follower minimum | hypjam
meta.description: Apply to join hypjam's UGC creator roster: paid briefs for UK and remote creators, no follower minimum, and the rate and usage agreed before you film.

hero.sub: Paid briefs for UK and remote creators, no follower minimum, and the rate and usage agreed before you film. We brief you like a director, not a client, then pay you like it mattered.

items: People who use their phone camera like a tool, not just a webcam.
Creators comfortable taking direction: hooks, retakes, notes, all of it.
A real point of view on camera, whether that is deadpan, chaotic or dead serious.
Niches we are always short on: skincare, home, fitness, food, tech unboxing, parenting.
Reliability: turning up to the call, hitting the deadline, saying something if it slips.

steps.name: Apply
steps.blurb: Send us a few links to your best work. It does not need to be viral; it needs to show you can hold a phone and a thought at the same time.

steps.name: Get matched
steps.blurb: When a brief fits your niche and style, we send it over with the script, references and everything you need to shoot without guessing.

steps.name: Shoot and submit
steps.blurb: You film on your phone, on your own time, and send us the raw footage. Our editors handle the cut, so you are not learning an edit suite on a deadline.

steps.name: Get paid
steps.blurb: Payment goes out on a set schedule once the video is approved. No chasing invoices, no waiting on the brand directly.

pay.p: Rates depend on the brief, the usage rights and how much whitelisting is involved. A simple organic testimonial pays differently to a paid Spark Ad with a three-month usage licence. We always tell you the rate and what it covers before you shoot, not after.

items.a: No. Your phone is genuinely enough. What matters is that you can act naturally on camera and follow a script without sounding like you are reading one.

items.q: Do I need a big following?
items.a: No. This is not influencer marketing: brands are paying for the content itself, not your audience, so your follower count does not decide whether you are cast.

items.q: How much creative freedom do I get?
items.a: You get a script and direction, but we want your delivery, timing and personality in there too. Directed, not read word for word.

items.q: Who owns the content I shoot?
items.a: The brand licenses it for the usage window agreed before you film, and we spell that out upfront. Organic-only jobs and whitelisted Spark Ads pay and license differently.

items.q: How often will I get briefed?
items.a: It varies. Some creators shoot for us monthly, others a few times a year, depending on how many briefs match your niche and availability.

items.q: Do I need to be in the UK?
items.a: hypjam is in London, but the roster is mostly remote. Most briefs need a phone, decent light and a bit of space to film.

apply.h2: Send us your best three links.
apply.p: There is no form. Email us with the details below and a person reads it. Applying does not guarantee work; it puts you on the list we cast from.
checklist: Two or three links to your strongest content
